language.name: English
common.name: Name
open.heading: Which computer do you want to open?
open.copy: Choose a computer, then return to one of its workspaces or add a new folder.
open.local_heading: Open a workspace on this computer
open.local_copy: Choose a folder location, return to an existing workspace, or open a new folder as a workspace.
open.locations_copy: Add another drive or project parent folder as a location.
open.location_copy: Folders under this path become browsable in the file UI, within the current OS user's permissions.
open.browse_folders_copy: Choose a folder by clicking through the directory list instead of typing a path.
open.folder_picker_empty: There are no subfolders to choose here.
open.direct_path_hint: You can still type the path directly if you know it.
open.registered_copy: Workspaces already opened from this location.
open.remote_registered_copy: Return directly to a workspace already registered on this computer.
open.workspaces_live_elsewhere: Workspace selection lives in one place
open.workspaces_live_elsewhere_copy: This page is only for SSH connection settings. Opening and adding workspaces is handled by Open workspace.
login.heading: Enter with your password
login.copy: Enter the password configured in TERMROOM_PASSWORD.
login.rate_limited: Too many login attempts. Try again shortly.
home.heading: Where do you want to continue?
home.copy: Return to a recent project, continue its terminal, and grab newly created files.
home.recent_workspaces_copy: Most recently used projects appear first.
home.no_workspace: No workspace has been opened yet.
home.no_workspace_copy: Open a project folder and it will appear here.
home.computer_section_copy: Choose workspaces from Open workspace; use this section to manage available computers and SSH connections.
ssh.add.heading: Connect remote Linux
ssh.add.copy: Termroom does not need to be installed on the remote computer. SSH and tmux are enough.
ssh.add.step_computer_copy: Use the same details you normally use for SSH.
ssh.add.config_hint: You can also enter a Host alias from ~/.ssh/config.
ssh.add.auth_copy: Choose either a password or an SSH public key.
ssh.add.password_copy: Keep connecting with the SSH password.
ssh.add.public_key_copy: Register Termroom's public key on the remote computer.
ssh.add.password_storage: Stored encrypted in the Termroom config directory. It is never placed in project files or the remote shell environment.
ssh.add.public_key_help: Add the line above to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for the remote user, then verify the server. The same key is reused while the config directory is preserved.
ssh.add.advanced: Advanced · use an existing SSH key
ssh.add.existing_copy: Specify a private key path accessible to Termroom Core.
ssh.add.private_key_placeholder: Leave blank to use IdentityFile from SSH config
ssh.add.private_key_help: Leave this blank when the SSH alias already has an IdentityFile.
ssh.add.verify_copy: Verify the host key once before saving.
ssh.add.fingerprint_confirm: I verified that this fingerprint belongs to the computer I want to connect to.
ssh.add.probing: Checking the server SSH host key…
ssh.error.proxy_unsupported: SSH aliases that require ProxyCommand or JumpHost are not supported by this setup screen yet.
ssh.error.host_key_required: Verify the SSH host key first.
ssh.error.host_key_changed: The SSH host key changed after verification. Nothing was saved.
ssh.error.existing_key_required: Enter an existing SSH private key path.
ssh.error.port_number: The SSH port must be a number.
ssh.error.port_range: The SSH port must be between 1 and 65535.
ssh.error.username_required: Could not determine the SSH username.
ssh.backend.credential_save: Could not store the SSH password securely.
ssh.backend.credential_missing: The stored SSH password is unavailable.
ssh.backend.credential_read: Could not read the stored SSH password.
ssh.backend.host_key_changed: The SSH host key no longer matches the approved fingerprint. Verify the server before reconnecting.
ssh.backend.ssh_missing: The Termroom Core does not have the OpenSSH client (ssh). Install it and retry.
ssh.backend.ssh_keygen_missing: ssh-keygen is required to create the Termroom public key. Install the OpenSSH client tools and retry.
ssh.backend.dns: Could not resolve the SSH address: {host}
ssh.backend.refused: SSH connection was refused. Check the SSH server and port at {host}:{port}.
ssh.backend.timeout: SSH connection timed out. Check the network path to {host}:{port}.
ssh.backend.auth: SSH authentication failed. Check the username and authentication settings.
ssh.detail.checked_copy: Termroom connected with the stored SSH credential and verified remote tmux availability.
ssh.detail.connected_copy: SSH authentication and tmux are working. You can now open a remote project path.
ssh.detail.open_project_copy: Type a project folder on the remote Linux computer or choose it with Browse folders. Termroom verifies the path and tmux before opening it.
ssh.detail.workspaces_copy: Jump back into a registered project.
ssh.detail.no_workspace: No remote project has been registered yet.
ssh.detail.update_password_copy: Termroom tests a real SSH connection with the new password before replacing the stored credential.
ssh.detail.password_updated_copy: The new password was verified and will be used for future reconnects.
ssh.detail.password_not_used: This computer does not use password authentication.
ssh.detail.remove_copy: Removes Termroom workspace, credential, and host-key records only. Remote tmux sessions and running processes are left untouched.
ssh.detail.remove_confirm: Remove the {name} registration? Remote processes will keep running.
terminal.name: Terminal name
terminal.close_confirm: Close this terminal? Processes running in this terminal will also stop.
terminal.command_edit_hint: Paste and edit a long command here before running it.
terminal.command_hint: Enter adds a line · Ctrl/⌘+Enter runs
terminal.first_hint: Commands keep running in this terminal even after you close the browser.
terminal.status.clipboard_insecure: The paste button requires HTTPS. Long-press the terminal or command editor to paste instead.
terminal.command_multiline: {lines} lines · review the full command before running
files.heading: Files
files.upload_conflict: Files with the same name already exist
files.upload_conflict_copy: Review the existing and new files before overwriting.
files.upload_cancelled: Upload cancelled. Files that already finished may remain.
files.upload_cancel_note: Multiple files are saved atomically one at a time. Files that already finished may remain after a cancel or later failure.
files.upload_auth_required: Your login session expired. Refresh the page and sign in again.
files.upload_refresh_required: Page validation expired. Refresh the page and try again.
files.error.no_upload: Choose at least one file to upload.
files.error.no_selection: Select files or folders to download.
files.error.too_many_selection: You can select up to 200 items at a time.
files.error.duplicate_upload: The same filename was selected twice: {name}
files.error.invalid_selection: The upload file selection is invalid.
files.error.too_large_generic: The upload exceeds the configured size limit.
file_view.sensitive: This file may contain sensitive information. The external share button is hidden.
file_view.preview_too_large: This file is too large for an inline browser preview.
file_view.preview_too_large_copy: Only the original download is offered to keep mobile browsers responsive.
file_view.head: Start of file
file_view.unsupported: No browser preview is available for this file
file_view.unsupported_copy: Termroom does not transform or interpret this file. Download the original instead.
recent.heading: Recent
recent.copy: Find the result of your latest run without digging through the file tree again.
recent.refresh_failed: Could not refresh the remote state. The information below may be from the last successful check. {error}
recent.files_copy: Files created or modified recently in this workspace. Termroom does not guess which command caused them.
recent.no_files_copy: Files will appear here after they are created or modified in this workspace.
recent.scan_limited: Recent-file scanning was limited for this large workspace. Checked up to {count} files.
recent.terminals_copy: Use the last-output time to quickly choose which session to inspect.
browse.heading: Open a folder as a workspace
browse.copy: Navigate to the folder you want to work in, then choose Open current folder.
browse.empty_copy: You can open this folder itself as a workspace.
editor.conflict_copy: Your submitted content is kept below. Saving again will overwrite the current file.
editor.save_failed: Could not save the file. Your edited content is still preserved below.
